{
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "incident_category", "analytical_usefulness": 0.9, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Categorizes tickets by type from short_description; provides a strong grouping axis for explaining duration variance. Sample readings (WiFi, VPN, database) are sound extractions."},
    {"name": "failure_mode", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "rationale": "Failure characterization is a useful axis for duration modeling. Most readings are warranted (connectivity, access_denied), but scope like 'full_outage'/'no_response'/'sync_failure' asserts operational detail not present in a terse short_description, so some values are weakly grounded inferences."},
    {"name": "affected_system_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.7, "source_groundedness": 0.9, "rationale": "System type is a reasonable grouping axis but heavily correlated with incident_category (VPN->vpn_server, database->database_server), so much of its leverage is redundant. Values are well grounded in the description text."},
    {"name": "affected_scope", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.5, "rationale": "Scope (individual vs system_wide) is a genuinely useful driver of resolution time. However the source text rarely states scope; e.g. 'Cannot connect to office WiFi' labeled 'individual' and 'Printing issues in office' labeled 'location_specific' are confident inferences the terse text does not clearly support."},
    {"name": "resolver_match", "analytical_usefulness": 0.55, "source_groundedness": 0.6, "rationale": "Presumably compares assigned_to vs closed_by/assigned_agent, potentially relevant to routing/duration. But grounding is questionable: row 1 shows resolver_match True with assigned_agent=Fred Luddy=closed_by, yet row 2 shows assigned_agent=Beth Anglin while closed_by=Charlie Whitherspoon and resolver_match=False — the derivation basis is inconsistent and partly unverifiable."},
    {"name": "assigned_agent", "analytical_usefulness": 0.3, "source_groundedness": 0.35, "rationale": "Largely redundant with existing assigned_to/closed_by columns, adding little new axis. More seriously, produced values contradict the source: row 2 source closed_by=Charlie Whitherspoon but assigned_agent=Beth Anglin; row 5 closed_by=Luke Wilson but assigned_agent=Charlie Whitherspoon — apparent hallucinated/misattributed assignments."},
    {"name": "open_hour_of_day", "analytical_usefulness": 0.75, "source_groundedness": 0.95, "rationale": "Time-of-day bucket derived correctly from opened_at (8:50->morning, 18:14->evening) gives a plausible new axis for duration variance (off-hours staffing)."},
    {"name": "caller_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.45, "source_groundedness": 0.55, "rationale": "named_user vs itil_user could relate to priority/handling. But basis in source is unclear and possibly derived from caller_id not shown; row 2 'itil_user' vs others 'named_user' cannot be verified from provided text, so grounding is uncertain."},
    {"name": "is_repeat_or_cluster_incident", "analytical_usefulness": 0.65, "source_groundedness": 0.3, "rationale": "Repeat/cluster status is analytically relevant, but with 461/500 flagged 'true' it is near-constant, reducing leverage. Grounding is weak: a single short_description does not reveal whether an incident is a repeat/cluster; these look like unsupported assertions."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.68,
  "source_groundedness": 0.62,
  "rationale": "The added columns supply several genuine grouping axes for explaining resolution-duration variance: incident_category, failure_mode, affected_scope, and open_hour_of_day are the strongest and mostly well grounded in short_description/opened_at. affected_system_type is useful but largely redundant with incident_category. Grounding weaknesses cluster in inferred/relational columns: assigned_agent contradicts the source closed_by in two of five samples (apparent hallucination), resolver_match has an inconsistent derivation, affected_scope over-asserts scope from terse text, and is_repeat_or_cluster_incident is both near-constant and unsupported by single-row text. Overall the set clears the usefulness bar comfortably but has notable grounding lapses."
}
